fulmĭnātus , a, um, adj. fulmino,
I.provided with thunder-bolts, bearing thunder: “legio XII. fulminata, probably because their shields bore the device of Jupiter brandishing the thunder-bolt,” Inscr. Orell. 517 ; 3174; Inscr. Murat. 869, 1; cf.: κεραυνοφόρον στρατόπεδον, Dio. Cass. 55, 23.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
